_comment: Storage proxy mount table. Copy to config.mounts.json (gitignored) and set ENABLE_STORAGE_PROXY=1. Each mount serves an S3 bucket as read-only byte passthrough from a backend, ALONGSIDE the relational->Iceberg path. Backends: 'local' (a filesystem path, incl. an OS-mounted NFS/SMB share), 's3' (a native upstream S3/MinIO/S3-compatible bucket), and 'azure' (a native Azure Blob/ADLS Gen2 container). 'root' is the filesystem path / upstream bucket / container respectively; secrets live in the encrypted credential store keyed by 'credential' (never inline) — a credential-less s3 mount must set 'auth' ('anonymous'/'instance'), a credential-less azure mount must set 'auth' ('default'/'managed_identity'/'anonymous'). The bucket must differ from the DB warehouse bucket (S3_BUCKET).
